descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Manyo no sato' Chartreuse Variegated Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Manyo no sato' is an introduction of Japanese maple that was introduced in Japan in 1993 and made popular by Yutaka Tunaka at Tsukasa Maple in Tokyo-to. It is a photographer's delight to photograph this beauty and I'm sure it will be your most popular photos on Instagram. 'Manyo no sato' leafs out in the early spring as a darker purple red with chartreuse variegation. The purple red color fades to a mauve red, then to a green in full sun during the summer in the south. 'Manyo no sato' turns to bright orange to red in the autumn. 'Manyo no sato' means "The Village of a 1,000 Leafs". 'Manyo no sato' may reach 8 ft tall by 6 ft wide in 10 years.

descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Manyo no sato'，黄绿色斑锦日本枫，适生区 5-9。 ‘Manyo no sato’ 是一个日本枫引种品种，1993 年在日本推出，并由东京 Tsukasa Maple 的 Yutaka Tunaka 推广开来。 这个品种上镜效果极佳，是摄影爱好者钟爱的美树，也很可能会成为你 Instagram 上最受欢迎的拍摄对象之一。 ‘Manyo no sato’ 早春展叶时呈较深的紫红色，并带有黄绿色斑锦。 到了夏季，在南方全日照条件下，紫红色会逐渐褪为淡紫红，随后转绿。 秋季叶色转为鲜橙至红色。 ‘Manyo no sato’ 的含义是“千叶之里”。 10 年左右可长至高 8 英尺、宽 6 英尺。
